## Purpose and Entry Points
Megatron-LM combines a reusable GPU-scale deep-learning library (Megatron Core) with reference training applications. It targets distributed training and inference for GPT, BERT, T5, hybrid/Mamba, MoE, and multimodal models. Primary executable entry points are `pretrain_gpt.py`, `pretrain_hybrid.py`, `pretrain_mamba.py`, `pretrain_vlm.py`, and `train_rl.py`; examples provide runnable model-specific launch scripts.

## Training Orchestration
The training layer parses arguments/configuration, initializes distributed execution, builds models/data/optimizers, and runs forward-backward-update/evaluation/checkpoint loops.
- `megatron/training/initialize.py`
- `megatron/training/training.py`
- `megatron/training/checkpointing.py`

It is the boundary between application scripts/model providers and Core primitives. Training config supports YAML-driven object instantiation under `megatron/training/config/`, while model-specific construction is supplied through root builders and `megatron/training/models/`.

## Model and Compute Layer
Core defines composable model implementations and transformer internals. GPT, BERT, T5, hybrid Transformer–SSM, vision/audio, LLaVA, and MiMo models assemble common embeddings, attention, MLPs, layer specifications, and transformer blocks.
- `megatron/core/models/gpt/gpt_model.py`
- `megatron/core/transformer/transformer_block.py`
- `megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py`

Mixture-of-Experts is a first-class transformer variant: routers select experts and token dispatchers execute cross-rank expert exchange.
- `megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_layer.py`
- `megatron/core/transformer/moe/router.py`
- `megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py`

CUDA/Triton/Transformer Engine-backed fusions and mixed-precision extensions sit beneath this API, isolating optimized kernels from model definitions.

## Distributed Execution and Memory
`parallel_state` and process-group configuration establish TP, PP, DP, context parallelism, and expert parallelism. Tensor-parallel layers shard model computation; pipeline schedules send activations/gradients between stages; DDP/FSDP and distributed optimizers manage parameter and gradient sharding.
- `megatron/core/parallel_state.py`
- `megatron/core/tensor_parallel/layers.py`
- `megatron/core/pipeline_parallel/schedules.py`
- `megatron/core/distributed/distributed_data_parallel.py`
- `megatron/core/optimizer/distrib_optimizer.py`

This layer depends on PyTorch distributed and GPU collective infrastructure, principally NCCL; optional resharding backends include Gloo, NIXL, and NVSHMEM.

## Data, State, and Checkpoints
Datasets convert indexed, blended, text, and multimodal corpora into rank-aware training samples and schedules.
- `megatron/core/datasets/blended_megatron_dataset_builder.py`
- `megatron/core/datasets/gpt_dataset.py`
- `megatron/core/tokenizers/utils/build_tokenizer.py`

Distributed checkpointing serializes sharded model/optimizer state, supports async and fully parallel strategies, and enables resume or topology changes. Resharding is a related runtime path for moving/refitting sharded state.
- `megatron/core/dist_checkpointing/core.py`
- `megatron/core/dist_checkpointing/strategies/fully_parallel.py`
- `megatron/core/resharding/planner.py`

Dataset object-storage support includes S3-oriented utilities; checkpoints otherwise form a filesystem/storage boundary.

## Inference and Serving
Inference is separate from training orchestration: high-level LLM APIs submit requests to static or dynamic engines, whose scheduler batches prefill/decode work and manages KV-cache contexts. Model wrappers adapt Core models to generation controllers and sampling.
- `megatron/core/inference/apis/llm.py`
- `megatron/core/inference/engines/dynamic_engine.py`
- `megatron/core/inference/scheduler.py`
- `megatron/core/inference/contexts/dynamic_context.py`

The dynamic text-generation server exposes completions/chat/health endpoints with OpenAI-style streaming.
- `megatron/core/inference/text_generation_server/dynamic_text_gen_server/text_generation_server.py`
- `megatron/core/inference/text_generation_server/dynamic_text_gen_server/endpoints/chat_completions.py`

ZMQ can coordinate asynchronous multi-replica inference; NCCL/NIXL can transfer disaggregated KV/SSM state.

## Export, Post-Training, and RL
Conversion/export is deliberately outside the core training loop: TensorRT-LLM export maps Core model state and builds engines.
- `megatron/core/export/trtllm/engine_builder/trtllm_engine_builder.py`
- `megatron/core/export/trtllm/trtllm_weights_converter/distributed_trtllm_model_weights_converter.py`

Post-training integrates ModelOpt-oriented model specs/state hooks, while RL separates agents, rollout inference, and optional FastAPI environment/inference servers.
- `megatron/core/post_training/modelopt/gpt/model_specs.py`
- `megatron/rl/agent/api.py`
- `megatron/rl/server/agent/fastapi_env_server.py`
